notes:
- New: Parameter sensitivity heatmap in Optimize This Instrument - pick any two swept parameters and a metric, see whether a good result comes from a broad, robust region or one lucky spike
- New: Monte Carlo trade resampling - new tab in Performance Report, bootstrap-resamples the trade sequence into a distribution of possible outcomes with percentile stats and probability of loss
- New: Rolling/Anchored Walk-Forward - new tab in Performance Report, re-runs the exact same strategy/parameters/costs on sequential date slices to check consistency over time
- Fixed: Basket table's per-stock equity curve thumbnails could silently render with the wrong (dark) background after using the new Optimize/Performance Report features in the same session - a shared chart-styling setting was being overwritten across unrelated parts of the app
